item.title: GSoC Week 13: How Much Does Rule Order Actually Cost?
item.description: Week thirteen had no new integration rules to show off. Instead it was seven pull requests closing out loose ends from earlier weeks, plus a side project that finally let me put a number on a question I'd been asking myself since week seven: when manualintegrate has several ways to solve an integral, how much does the order in which it tries them actually matter?
